I’m Daejeong Kim, a maker who turns possibilities into opportunities and delivers value through products.

blocks.text: Tech Lead · Backend Engineer | Full-time, early member

Proposed Thready and led its development, launch, and operation as a paid subscription product with teammates in product planning, QA, and marketing. It helps creators already active on Instagram, YouTube, or blogs establish a presence on Threads despite limited time and unfamiliar platform conventions.
Built and operated the product backend and AI generation and evaluation systems; implemented core user and admin workflows with coding agents.

Separated product policy and records from AI execution in an independent service and database. Implemented a transactional outbox with leases, attempt tokens, retries, and version checks to control stale workers and duplicate or out-of-order delivery.
Implemented scheduled draft generation and approval notifications, transactional approval commands, and publishing recovery that distinguishes pre-call failures from uncertain external results.

Led order and inventory backend development and a Redis-based SSO session redesign for a dermatology operations product suite. Co-led real-time AI consultation backend development and implemented reservation policies and operational integrations.
Led backend architecture and website and admin API development for multi-clinic operations and reservations.
Implemented APIs, review workflows, and publication controls for a procedure-information knowledge service; preparing clinical evaluation materials and search-data release approval.

Built the organization’s standard backend template, enabling teammates across disciplines to implement features with coding agents. Led product planning, issue tracking, and releases; contributed to the design of AI-assisted company workflows and handled service deployment and routine cloud operations.
